title: The Racist Theory Behind So Many Mass Shootings

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做 DJ 时，你每晚也要带着 300 件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，然后你把 DJ 台

sentences.en: into this living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: We begin tonight with breaking news, a mass shooting in Buffalo, New York.
sentences.zh: 今晚我们从突发新闻开始，纽约州布法罗市发生了一起大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: Witnesses say a gunman dressed in army fatigues and a helmet walked into a supermarket and then opened fire on shoppers and staff.
sentences.zh: 目击者称，一名身穿军装、头戴头盔的枪手走进一家超市，随后向购物者和工作人员开火。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, an 18-year-old man drove several hours from his home to a grocery store in Buffalo, New York,
sentences.zh: 周末，一名 18 岁的男子从家中开车数小时，来到纽约州布法罗市的一家杂货店，

sentences.en: where he live-streamed himself shooting 13 people and killing 10 of them.
sentences.zh: 并在那里直播了自己枪击 13 人并导致其中 10 人死亡的过程。

sentences.en: You could hear where the gunshots were, how close they were coming, and I said, where's my baby?
sentences.zh: 你能听到枪声在哪里，它们离得有多近，我当时说，我的孩子在哪里？

sentences.en: I said, my baby, where is she?
sentences.zh: 我说，我的孩子，她在哪里？

sentences.en: I didn't know where she was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: He shot a woman, he shot a deacon, he shot another woman, and then he went in.
sentences.zh: 他射杀了一名妇女，射杀了一名执事，射杀了另一名妇女，然后走了进去。

sentences.en: Among the victims was a retired police officer, a church deacon, and a grandmother of eight.
sentences.zh: 受害者中包括一名退休警官、一名教会执事和一位八个孩子的祖母。

sentences.en: It's hard to even muster.
sentences.zh: 这让人难以言表。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 简直不可思议。

sentences.en: I'm lost of words.
sentences.zh: 我无言以对。

sentences.en: You know, I frequent this store all the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我经常来这家店。

sentences.en: I've never been afraid to be here.
sentences.zh: 我从来没觉得在这里不安全。

sentences.en: I am now.
sentences.zh: 现在有了。

sentences.en: I am now.
sentences.zh: 现在有了。

sentences.en: Within hours, it became clear that the shooter's intent was to kill as many Black people as possible.
sentences.zh: 几小时内，枪手的意图就很明确了，那就是尽可能多地杀害黑人。

sentences.en: Authorities discovered a hate-filled manifesto filled with racist theories.
sentences.zh: 当局发现了一份充满种族主义理论的仇恨宣言。

sentences.en: and an anti-black racial slur could be seen on the barrel of his assault rifle.
sentences.zh: 在他的突击步枪枪管上还能看到反黑人的种族歧视用语。

sentences.en: Eleven of the victims said to be African-American.
sentences.zh: 据称 11 名受害者是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: Officials are calling this a racially motivated hate crime.
sentences.zh: 官员们称这是一起种族动机的仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: And that he was the latest mass shooter to be motivated by a racist idea known as the Great Replacement Theory.
sentences.zh: 他也是最新一名受到被称为“大置换理论”的种族主义思想驱动的大规模枪手。

sentences.en: My colleague Nick Confessori has been reporting on the origins of that theory and how it is simultaneously becoming more extreme and more mainstream.
sentences.zh: 我的同事尼克·孔费索里一直在报道该理论的起源，以及它如何同时变得更加极端和主流化。

sentences.en: It's Monday, May 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 5 月 16 日，星期一。

sentences.en: Nick, where do we need to begin to understand the origins of this theory that keeps showing up in all of these really horrific mass shootings?
sentences.zh: 尼克，我们要从哪里开始理解这个不断出现在所有这些极其恐怖的大规模枪击事件中的理论起源呢？

sentences.en: Michael, at the root of this is the idea that white people in Europe or America are on the losing end and are in some kind of a decline.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，其根源在于一种观点，即欧洲或美国的白人正处于失败的一方，正处于某种衰落之中。

sentences.en: And you can find variations of replacement theory, as it's called, going back decades.
sentences.zh: 你可以发现所谓的“置换理论”的变体可以追溯到几十年前。

sentences.en: You can look in the 1990s at actual neo-Nazi rhetoric about a genocide against white people.
sentences.zh: 你可以看看 20 世纪 90 年代关于针对白人种族灭绝的实际新纳粹言论。

sentences.en: And you can find versions of this in Europe, starting in the 2010s, with the publication of a book in France called The Great Replacement,
sentences.zh: 你可以在 2010 年代初的欧洲找到这种理论的版本，当时法国出版了一本名为《大置换》的书，

sentences.en: which held that the elite class in Europe was trying to import a group of Muslims and Africans and Arabs to Europe
sentences.zh: 该书认为欧洲的精英阶层正试图将一群穆斯林、非洲人和阿拉伯人引入欧洲，

sentences.en: to replace the native-born white population and the Christian population.
sentences.zh: 以取代本土出生的白人和基督教人口。

sentences.en: And you can find a version of replacement theory in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在美国找到置换理论的一个版本，

sentences.en: more recently, where in place of those Syrian refugees or Muslim refugees, the villain is South American migrants and Latin American migrants.
sentences.zh: 最近，那些叙利亚难民或穆斯林难民被南美移民和拉丁美洲移民所取代，成为了反派。

sentences.en: But all of them have something in common, which is that white people in Europe, in America, in New Zealand, are being replaced by people of color.
sentences.zh: 但它们都有一个共同点，那就是欧洲、美国和新西兰的白人正在被有色人种所取代。

sentences.en: And that this is a deliberate effort on the part of elites in these countries in these parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 而且这是这些国家和世界这些地区的精英们蓄意为之的努力。

sentences.en: Sometimes the elites are under the sway of Jews who are orchestrating this Great Replacement.
sentences.zh: 有时精英们受到犹太人的左右，是他们在策划这场“大置换”。

sentences.en: Sometimes the elites are businesses and political leaders who want votes from the new arrivals.
sentences.zh: 有时精英们是想要新移民选票的企业和政治领袖。

sentences.en: Like all conspiracy theories, the Great Replacement provides, for some people, a comforting and also angering explanation for changes that they see around them.
sentences.zh: 像所有阴谋论一样，“大置换”为某些人提供了一种既令人宽慰又令人愤怒的解释，来解释他们周围所见的变化。

sentences.en: So in the simplest terms, this theory, the replacement theory, taps into the changing demographics of many Western, predominantly white countries,
sentences.zh: 简而言之，这个理论，即置换理论，利用了许多西方以白人为主的国家不断变化的人口结构，

sentences.en: and the particular fears of white nationalists in all of these places.
sentences.zh: 以及所有这些地方白人民族主义者的特殊恐惧。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In Europe, in the U.S., you have countries that are changing.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，在美国，你拥有正在发生变化的国家。

sentences.en: In Europe, it's partly the result of refugees and migrants from the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，这部分是来自中东的难民和移民的结果。

sentences.en: In the U.S., you have a growing Hispanic population, partly immigration-driven.
sentences.zh: 在美国，你拥有不断增长的拉美裔人口，部分是由移民驱动的。

sentences.en: And what's really striking, Michael, is that in a whole string of mass shootings around the world and in the U.S., we have seen the same theme, replacement, cited again and again.
sentences.zh: 真正引人注目的是，迈克尔，在世界各地和美国发生的一连串大规模枪击事件中，我们一次又一次地看到了同样的主题：置换。

sentences.en: We saw it in the manifesto from the shooter in Christchurch in New Zealand,
sentences.zh: 我们在新西兰基督城枪手的宣言中看到了这一点，

sentences.en: and we saw it in what law enforcement officials tell us is a manifesto that the gunman in Buffalo posted shortly before his rampage at a supermarket there.
sentences.zh: 我们在执法官员告诉我们的布法罗枪手在超市大开杀戒前不久发布的宣言中也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: And in fact, the Buffalo Killers Manifesto was partly cut and pasted from the Christchurch Manifesto.
sentences.zh: 事实上，布法罗枪手的宣言部分是从基督城宣言中剪切粘贴过来的。

sentences.en: And it just shows you how in the online world where a lot of these people, and it's mostly men and white men, are inhabiting, these ideas freely circulate and bounce around.
sentences.zh: 这向你展示了在这些人的网络世界里——主要是男性，白人男性——这些思想是如何自由流通并四处传播的。

sentences.en: And they're borrowed and remixed and recirculated.
sentences.zh: 它们被借用、重新混合并再次传播。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It seems to actually tell the story of how readily this theory weaves its way across the Internet.
sentences.zh: 这似乎确实讲述了这个理论是如何轻易地在互联网上传播的故事。

sentences.en: Do we know precisely how this man in Buffalo, this young man in Buffalo, came to discover the replacement theory and to be radicalized by it?
sentences.zh: 我们是否确切知道布法罗的这个人，这个布法罗的年轻人，是如何发现置换理论并被其激进化的？

sentences.en: So there are some hints in the 180-page document that this man in Buffalo posted before the shooting.
sentences.zh: 布法罗的这个人发布的那份 180 页的文件中确实有一些线索。

sentences.en: And by his own account, he started going on web forums like 4chan and 8chan because he was bored during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 据他自己说，他开始浏览 4chan 和 8chan 这样的网络论坛，因为他在疫情期间感到无聊。

sentences.en: He got his news from Reddit and he was finding these ideas on these sources and they circulate freely there.
sentences.zh: 他从 Reddit 获取新闻，并在这些来源上发现了这些思想，它们在那里自由流通。

sentences.en: It's done with irony and humor.
sentences.zh: 这是以讽刺和幽默的方式完成的。

sentences.en: It's openly raciSt.
sentences.zh: 这是公开的种族主义。

sentences.en: It is ideas and memes about the inferiority of black people, about the violence, supposedly, of black people, and a ton of anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 这是关于黑人低劣、关于黑人所谓暴力以及大量反犹太主义的思想和模因。

sentences.en: There are things he posted in his document, borrowed from elsewhere on the internet, it appears,
sentences.zh: 他在文件中发布了一些似乎是从互联网其他地方借来的内容，

sentences.en: in which he charts the number of Jews he believes are working at the upper ranks of places like the New York Times and even Fox News.
sentences.zh: 他在其中列出了他认为在《纽约时报》甚至福克斯新闻等机构高层工作的犹太人数量。

sentences.en: And what binds it all together is this idea that there is an inferior group, a racially inferior group, that is outpacing and replacing the racially superior group,
sentences.zh: 将这一切联系在一起的是这样一种观点：存在一个劣等群体，一个种族上的劣等群体，正在超越并取代种族上的优等群体，

sentences.en: which is white people.
sentences.zh: 也就是白人。

sentences.en: And that the people moving it along and making it happen, in the case of the Buffalo Killer, are Jews and elites and assorted others.
sentences.zh: 而在布法罗枪手的案例中，推动这一进程并使其成为现实的人是犹太人、精英和其他各类人。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And I'm reluctant to get into the details of what is obviously a very flawed and extreme document.
sentences.zh: 我不愿深入探讨这份显然非常拙劣和极端的文件的细节。

sentences.en: But how does this shooter justify targeting Black Americans?
sentences.zh: 但这个枪手是如何证明针对非裔美国人的合理性的呢？

sentences.en: Because, Nick, from what you said about the replacement theory as it is generally understood in the U.S., it seems to not be especially focused on black Americans,
sentences.zh: 因为，尼克，根据你所说的美国普遍理解的置换理论，它似乎并不是特别针对非裔美国人，

sentences.en: but instead on those coming from Latin America.
sentences.zh: 而是针对那些来自拉丁美洲的人。

sentences.en: So how does he make that connection?
sentences.zh: 那么他是如何建立这种联系的呢？

sentences.en: Well, here we come back to the idea of how malleable this conspiracy theory is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这里我们又回到了这个阴谋论有多么灵活的观点上。

sentences.en: Most versions of replacement theory, as you can imagine, have a particular group or groups who are the replacers.
sentences.zh: 正如你可以想象的那样，大多数版本的置换理论都有一个特定的群体或多个群体作为“置换者”。

sentences.en: And in the document that he posted, he describes black people, and this will echo whorey old racist themes and prejudices.
sentences.zh: 在他发布的文档中，他描述了黑人——这会呼应陈旧的种族主义主题和偏见。

sentences.en: He describes black people as a culture with higher fertility rates that seeks to occupy his people's lands and ethnically replace his people.
sentences.zh: 他将黑人描述为一种具有更高生育率的文化，试图占据他人民的土地并从种族上取代他的人民。

sentences.en: So, he says in this document that all black people are replacers just by existing in white countries.
sentences.zh: 所以，他在文件中说，所有黑人仅仅因为存在于白人国家就都是置换者。

sentences.en: In a Q&A he posted to his followers, he asked himself the question, so why attack immigrants when Jews are the issue?
sentences.zh: 在他发布给追随者的问答中，他问自己一个问题：既然犹太人才是问题所在，为什么要攻击移民？

sentences.en: And why attack blacks if high fertility immigrants, as he calls them, are the issue?
sentences.zh: 如果高生育率的移民（正如他所称的那样）是问题所在，为什么要攻击黑人？

sentences.en: And he basically says, I'll destroy them one by one, but I'm going to start with these black people in Buffalo.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，我会一个一个地消灭他们，但我打算从布法罗的这些黑人开始。

sentences.en: And elsewhere in the document, he asks rhetorically, am I a white supremacist?
sentences.zh: 在文件的其他地方，他反问道：我是白人至上主义者吗？

sentences.en: And he says, yes.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的。

sentences.en: So the Buffalo shooter was an explicit and open white supremaciSt.
sentences.zh: 所以布法罗枪手是一个明确且公开的白人至上主义者。

sentences.en: He was espousing the most extreme and hateful versions of replacement theory.
sentences.zh: 他信奉的是置换理论中最极端、最仇恨的版本。

sentences.en: But what we're seeing now more and more in American life is a version of replacement theory, a variation, shorn of the explicit references to anti-Semitic and anti-Black themes.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在在美国生活中越来越多地看到的是置换理论的一个版本，一个变体，剔除了对反犹太和反黑人主题的明确提及。

sentences.en: And it's becoming central in conservative politics and media.
sentences.zh: 它正成为保守派政治和媒体的核心。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《交易手册》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市的“交易手册峰会”现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得一个月免费访问我们所有新闻报道的权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: So Nick, describe how a variation of the replacement theory is starting to show up in American media and politics.
sentences.zh: 那么尼克，请描述一下置换理论的变体是如何开始出现在美国媒体和政治中的。

sentences.en: What we see in more mainstream circles is a version of replacement theory focused on immigration and the problem of legal immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们在更主流的圈子里看到的是一个专注于移民和合法移民问题的置换理论版本。

sentences.en: There was a poll released last week by the Associated Press that shows that one in three American adults believe that an effort is underway to, quote,
sentences.zh: 美联社上周发布的一项民意调查显示，三分之一的美国成年人认为，目前正在进行一项努力，即引用：

sentences.en: replace native-born Americans with immigrants for electoral gains.
sentences.zh: 为了选举利益，用移民取代本土出生的美国人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: One-third of Americans.
sentences.zh: 三分之一的美国人。

sentences.en: One-third.
sentences.zh: 三分之一。

sentences.en: So how do you explain that?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何解释这一点？

sentences.en: Because the platforms that you have mentioned so far as trafficking in replacement theory are not used by all that many Americans.
sentences.zh: 因为你目前提到的那些传播置换理论的平台并没有被那么多美国人使用。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Most Americans yet are not on 4chan and 8chan, although they're popular with some people, especially young people.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国人还没有使用 4chan 和 8chan，尽管它们在某些人，尤其是年轻人中很受欢迎。

sentences.en: But these ideas, or a version of them, are now more broadly circulated.
sentences.zh: 但这些思想，或其变体，现在被更广泛地传播了。

sentences.en: And one place you can find replacement theory is the most popular show on cable news.
sentences.zh: 你可以在有线电视新闻中最受欢迎的节目中找到置换理论。

sentences.en: Tucker Carlson Tonight.
sentences.zh: 《塔克·卡尔森今晚秀》。

sentences.en: Good evening and welcome to Tucker Carlson Tonight.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，欢迎收看《塔克·卡尔森今晚秀》。

sentences.en: You may have...
sentences.zh: 你可能已经……

sentences.en: Right, which was the subject, Nick, of a months-long investigation by you and our colleagues that just published.
sentences.zh: 没错，尼克，这正是你和我们的同事刚刚发表的一项长达数月调查的主题。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Our reporting showed that a variation on replacement theory focused on immigration has figured in over 400 episodes of Carlson's show.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道显示，一个专注于移民的置换理论变体出现在卡尔森节目的 400 多集中。

sentences.en: Staggering.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊。

sentences.en: Now, I know that the left and all the little gatekeepers on Twitter become literally hysterical if you use the term replacement.
sentences.zh: 现在，我知道左派和推特上的所有小守门人如果使用“置换”这个词，就会变得歇斯底里。

sentences.en: If you suggest the Democratic Party is trying to replace the current electorate, the voters now casting ballots, with new people, more obedient voters from the third world.
sentences.zh: 如果你暗示民主党正试图用新的人，来自第三世界的更顺从的选民，来取代当前的选民群体，即现在投票的选民。

sentences.en: But they become hysterical because that's what's happening, actually.
sentences.zh: 但他们变得歇斯底里是因为这确实正在发生。

sentences.en: Let's just say it.
sentences.zh: 我们直说吧。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: Now, the version that you will hear on
sentences.zh: 现在，你在《塔克·卡尔森今晚秀》上听到的版本，

sentences.en: Tucker Carlson tonight is significantly different than the version you will see on the manifestos of mass shooters in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与你在美国大规模枪手宣言中看到的版本有很大不同。

sentences.en: In a democracy, one person equals one vote.
sentences.zh: 在民主国家，一人一票。

sentences.en: If you change the population, you dilute the political power of the people who live there.
sentences.zh: 如果你改变了人口结构，你就稀释了居住在那里的人们的政治权力。

sentences.en: So every time they import a new voter, I become disenfranchised as a current voter.
sentences.zh: 所以每次他们引入一个新选民，作为现有选民的我就会被剥夺权利。

sentences.en: It is shorn of the anti-Semitism for the most part.
sentences.zh: 它在很大程度上剔除了反犹太主义。

sentences.en: It does not blame replacement on Jews.
sentences.zh: 它不把置换归咎于犹太人。

sentences.en: In place of a Jewish conspiracy is a broader cabal of the ruling class,
sentences.zh: 取代犹太阴谋的是一个更广泛的统治阶级阴谋集团，

sentences.en: Democrats and Republicans and big business.
sentences.zh: 民主党人、共和党人和大企业。

sentences.en: For Democrats, it's understandable because the calculus is simple.
sentences.zh: 对于民主党人来说，这是可以理解的，因为算计很简单。

sentences.en: Having abandoned the concerns of the middle class here, they need millions of new voters and they need them faSt.
sentences.zh: 在抛弃了这里中产阶级的关切后，他们需要数百万新选民，而且他们需要得很快。

sentences.en: Otherwise, their party risks becoming a permanent minority.
sentences.zh: 否则，他们的政党就有沦为永久少数派的风险。

sentences.en: Replacing ungrateful citizens with obedient immigrants is their only hope.
sentences.zh: 用顺从的移民取代不知感恩的公民是他们唯一的希望。

sentences.en: Every Democrat who's thought it through for even a minute knows this well.
sentences.zh: 每一个认真思考过这一点的民主党人都很清楚这一点。

sentences.en: Democrats who want more votes and an immigration policy that, in Carlson's narrative, is designed to allow more people in,
sentences.zh: 想要更多选票的民主党人，以及在卡尔森的叙事中，旨在允许更多人进入的移民政策，

sentences.en: people who are different than the people who are here already.
sentences.zh: 那些与已经在这里的人不同的人。

sentences.en: He is saying, night after night, that the people who run the country hate the rest of us, hate them, want to destroy them, and are doing it by importing these voters,
sentences.zh: 他每晚都在说，统治这个国家的人憎恨我们其他人，憎恨他们，想要摧毁他们，并且正通过引入这些选民来做到这一点，

sentences.en: because in his mind, immigrants are natural Democrats.
sentences.zh: 因为在他看来，移民是天生的民主党人。

sentences.en: And they will eventually create a more democratic electorate.
sentences.zh: 他们最终会创造一个更民主的选民群体。

sentences.en: In political terms, this policy is called the Great Replacement, the replacement of legacy Americans with more obedient people from faraway countries.
sentences.zh: 在政治术语中，这项政策被称为“大置换”，即用来自遥远国家的更顺从的人取代传统美国人。

sentences.en: Carlson doesn't talk about white people being the equivalent of the native-born, but he does talk about legacy Americans, a term that, until he began using it last fall,
sentences.zh: 卡尔森不谈论白人等同于本土出生的人，但他确实谈论“传统美国人”，这个词直到他去年秋天开始使用它之前，

sentences.en: was basically only present on white nationalist websites.
sentences.zh: 基本上只出现在白人民族主义网站上。

sentences.en: It didn't exist in the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 这在主流媒体中并不存在。

sentences.en: And then Biden went further.
sentences.zh: 随后拜登更进一步。

sentences.en: He said that non-white DNA is the, quote, source of our strength.
sentences.zh: 他说非白人的DNA是，引用他的话，我们力量的源泉。

sentences.en: Imagine saying that.
sentences.zh: 想象一下竟然会这么说。

sentences.en: It's horrifying.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: It's different than what you will find on a white nationalist site.
sentences.zh: 这和你会在白人至上主义网站上看到的内容有所不同。

sentences.en: But at its core is the same beating heart, which is this fear of demographic changes that are happening mostly naturally and putting a conspiracy behind the change.
sentences.zh: 但其核心跳动着同样的心脏，那就是对人口结构变化的恐惧，这种变化大多是自然发生的，而人们却在背后编造阴谋论。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And when we talk about a show like Tucker Carlson's, we are talking about not a small audience, but a very large one.
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论像塔克·卡尔森（Tucker Carlson）这样的节目时，我们谈论的不是一小部分受众，而是非常庞大的群体。

sentences.en: It's a very large audience by the standards of cable television.
sentences.zh: 以有线电视的标准来看，这是一个非常庞大的受众群体。

sentences.en: Three million people or more on every night.
sentences.zh: 每晚有三百万甚至更多的人观看。

sentences.en: And his audience is 92% white and four-fifths over the age of 54.
sentences.zh: 而且他的受众中92%是白人，五分之四的人年龄在54岁以上。

sentences.en: And it's not just the number of people listening.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是收听人数的问题。

sentences.en: It's the influence that Carlson has on broader Republican circles, politicians, campaigns, because of his power with primary voters,
sentences.zh: 这是卡尔森对更广泛的共和党圈子、政客和竞选活动的影响力，因为他在初选选民中拥有强大的号召力，

sentences.en: because his audience is very loyal to him and to Fox, and because they tune in every night.
sentences.zh: 因为他的受众对他和福克斯新闻非常忠诚，而且他们每晚都会收看。

sentences.en: He can really shape the discourse on the right.
sentences.zh: 他确实能够塑造右翼的话语体系。

sentences.en: He can shape what ideas are considered mainstream and acceptable.
sentences.zh: 他能决定哪些观点被认为是主流和可接受的。

sentences.en: And so even a version of replacement theory that is sort of sanded down then becomes something that is talked about openly on the top-rated show in cable news.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使是那种经过“打磨”的“替代理论”版本，也会成为有线电视新闻收视率最高的节目中公开讨论的话题。

sentences.en: And Nick, how do we see the more mainstream version of this replacement theory showing up not just in media but in politics?
sentences.zh: 尼克，我们该如何看待这种“替代理论”的主流版本不仅出现在媒体中，也出现在政治领域？

sentences.en: You mentioned that it has emerged in politics.
sentences.zh: 你提到它已经出现在政治中了。

sentences.en: So where do we see that?
sentences.zh: 那么我们在哪里能看到这一点？

sentences.en: How do we see that?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待它？

sentences.en: We see more and more examples in recent years and even in just the past year.
sentences.zh: 近年来，甚至就在过去一年里，我们看到了越来越多的例子。

sentences.en: Newt Gingrich went on Fox and said that leftists were trying to, quote, drown out what he called, quote, classic Americans.
sentences.zh: 纽特·金里奇（Newt Gingrich）在福克斯新闻上说，左派正试图，引用他的话，淹没他所谓的“经典美国人”。

sentences.en: Elise Stefanik, who's the third-ranking Republican in Congress, released a campaign ad on Facebook claiming that Democrats were plotting, quote,
sentences.zh: 国会排名第三的共和党人埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）在Facebook上发布了一则竞选广告，声称民主党人正在策划，引用，

sentences.en: quote, a permanent election insurrection by granting amnesty to millions of legal immigrants, which she claimed in her ad would, quote, overthrow our current electorate and create
sentences.zh: 引用，“一场永久性的选举叛乱”，通过给予数百万合法移民大赦，她在广告中声称这将，引用，“推翻我们当前的选民群体，并创造

sentences.en: a permanent liberal majority in Washington.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿永久的自由派多数派”。

sentences.en: We saw another Republican congressman,
sentences.zh: 我们看到了另一位共和党国会议员，

sentences.en: Matt Gaetz of Florida, defend Mr. Carlson's rhetoric in 2021 and say, quote, Tucker Carlson is correct about replacement theory as he explains what is happening in America.
sentences.zh: 来自佛罗里达州的马特·盖茨（Matt Gaetz），在2021年为卡尔森先生的言论辩护，并说，引用，“塔克·卡尔森关于替代理论的说法是正确的，他解释了美国正在发生的事情”。

sentences.en: Now, I should be clear that these politicians, in their own framings of these issues, are not using calls to violence.
sentences.zh: 现在，我必须明确一点，这些政客在他们自己对这些问题的表述中，并没有呼吁暴力。

sentences.en: They are not echoing anti-Black rhetoric or anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 他们没有附和反黑人或反犹太主义的言论。

sentences.en: But in their discussion and attack on immigration, I think you can hear and see the echoes of replacement theory in their own language,
sentences.zh: 但在他们对移民的讨论和攻击中，我认为你可以听到并看到他们自己的语言中回荡着“替代理论”的影子，

sentences.en: of real Americans being diminished, disempowered, even cheated by immigrants and their enablers in the elite and the ruling class.
sentences.zh: 即真正的美国人正被移民及其在精英和统治阶层中的支持者所削弱、剥夺权力，甚至被欺骗。

sentences.en: So Nick, how are you thinking about these kind of two forms of this theory and how they have taken root and been disseminated?
sentences.zh: 那么尼克，你是如何看待这种理论的两种形式，以及它们是如何扎根并传播开来的？

sentences.en: The simultaneous mainstreaming of this theory and the extremist violent iteration of it we saw over the weekend in Buffalo, the relationship between this version that a third
sentences.zh: 这种理论的主流化与我们在周末布法罗看到的极端暴力事件同时发生，这种关系在于，三分之一的

sentences.en: of Americans are worried about and perhaps digesting through cable news or the Facebook feed of a lawmaker and the violent version in which people end up dead.
sentences.zh: 美国人所担心的，或许是通过有线电视新闻或立法者的Facebook动态所吸收的内容，与导致人们死亡的暴力版本之间的联系。

sentences.en: I think that in some ways, both a violent extremist like the gunman in Buffalo and a
sentences.zh: 我认为在某种程度上，无论是像布法罗枪手那样的暴力极端分子，还是

sentences.en: talk show host, like Tucker Carlson, are drawing on the same well, the same sewer even, of ideas and anger and fear.
sentences.zh: 像塔克·卡尔森这样的脱口秀主持人，都在汲取同一个源头，甚至可以说是同一个充满思想、愤怒和恐惧的下水道。

sentences.en: And the central fear is that there are many people who are very worried about what the country will be if people who look like them don't dominate it numerically, aren't the
sentences.zh: 核心的恐惧在于，有许多人非常担心，如果长得不像他们的人在数量上不占主导地位，如果他们不再是

sentences.en: default.
sentences.zh: 默认的群体，这个国家会变成什么样。

sentences.en: And there are many people who are upset and who feel that there are too many people coming into the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 有许多人感到不安，觉得有太多人非法进入这个国家。

sentences.en: That's the emotional wellspring of all of this.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一切的情感源泉。

sentences.en: And versions of replacement, whether the extreme version that you saw in the manifesto from the Buffalo Gunman, or the sanded down version that still calls itself replacement
sentences.zh: 而“替代”的各种版本，无论是你在布法罗枪手的宣言中看到的极端版本，还是那种仍然自称为“替代

sentences.en: theory they're all downstream of that fear and they're all harnessing it in different ways i
sentences.zh: 理论”的经过打磨的版本，它们都是这种恐惧的下游产物，并且都在以不同的方式利用它。我认为

sentences.en: think that the reason you see this kind of rhetoric this style of argument spreading in republican
sentences.zh: 你在共和党圈子里看到这种修辞和这种论证风格传播的原因，

sentences.en: circles is because it taps into a genuine worry and it's a way of of generating engagement and
sentences.zh: 是因为它触及了一种真实的担忧，这是一种产生参与度的方式，

sentences.en: that sounds bloodless but this is what i mean by that it generates ratings and retweets it gets people to contribute small donations online to politicians.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很冷血，但这就是我的意思：它能带来收视率和转发量，促使人们在网上向政客捐赠小额款项。

sentences.en: It's a powerful and potent idea, even if it's wrong, and even if it's sanded down, to make it a little more palatable and to make it sound a little bit less crazy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个强大而有力的观点，即使它是错误的，即使它经过了打磨，使其更容易被接受，听起来不那么疯狂。

sentences.en: I think when we see the sanded down version, the one that sounds a little closer to a broader critique of unchecked immigration, you start to legitimate
sentences.zh: 我认为当我们看到经过打磨的版本时，那种听起来更接近于对不受限制的移民进行更广泛批评的版本，你就开始使

sentences.en: the darker version a little and i think it's all a process again we talk about this idea of
sentences.zh: 更黑暗的版本变得合法化了。我认为这又是一个过程，我们谈论“主流化”这个概念，

sentences.en: mainstreaming and it might be a tired term but when you take a attenuated version of an extreme
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个陈词滥调，但当你采用一个极端思想的减弱版本，

sentences.en: idea and get behind it and promote it as the truth you suddenly inched a really big audience
sentences.zh: 并支持它、将其作为真理进行推广时，你突然让一个非常庞大的受众群体

sentences.en: a bit closer to the much more extreme version that is out there on the internet waiting for them to find it.
sentences.zh: 离互联网上等待他们发现的、更极端的版本又近了一步。

sentences.en: Well, Nick, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，尼克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.zh: 但他几天后就被释放，并很快消失在警方的视线中。

sentences.en: At the end of this weekend's rampage, he appeared ready to fulfill his earlier plan, putting a gun to his neck, but officers persuaded him to drop the weapon and surrender.
sentences.zh: 在本周末的暴行结束时，他似乎准备实现他早先的计划，将枪抵在自己的脖子上，但警官们说服他放下武器并投降。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）主持的最新一期《地铁》（Metro）节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
